spanish: Y lo degollará sobre muslo del altar, hacia el norte, delante de Jehová, y echarán hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, su sangre sobre el altar alrededor.
grammarChanges: Replaced the name-like transliteration 'Tsafónah' with the directional phrase 'hacia el norte', translating H6828 (common noun 'north', feminine singular absolute) plus its directional suffix as direction rather than leaving it as an untranslated proper name.
